subject.title: fix(hooks): wire message:sending internal hook to user-defined hooks

question: Should user-defined internal hooks gain a supported `message:sending` notification, and if so must it observe only post-policy final content under the canonical colon-form key?
rationale: Current public documentation does not promise this event and reserves modification or cancellation for typed plugin hooks, so accepting a new core lifecycle event and its security-sensitive timing requires owner intent rather than a mechanical bug-fix assumption.

options.title: Add a post-policy notification
options.body: Support one canonical `message:sending` event after modification or cancellation resolves, emitting only accepted final content exactly once.

options.title: Keep internal hooks unchanged
options.body: Decline the new event and direct pre-delivery policy users to typed plugin hooks while retaining `message:sent` for internal notification.

recommendation.title: Add a post-policy notification
recommendation.body: Support one canonical `message:sending` event after modification or cancellation resolves, emitting only accepted final content exactly once.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related member-authored work currently owns the exactly-once placement and policy semantics of `message_sending` across outbound paths.
